title: tenant-isolated-prometheus-operator-configurator-and-dashboard-hydration
author: Evelyn Park
description:
Motivation: Private installs currently run a single Prometheus instance for all tenants which causes noisy "metrics blast" during tenant onboarding and makes per-tenant retention/alerting isolation risky. This PR introduces a lightweight operator/configurator that provisions tenant-scoped Prometheus workloads (either tenant-specific PrometheusRule + ServiceMonitor sets or per-tenant Thanos sidecars depending on install profile) and a GitOps-driven dashboard hydration job that ensures each tenant receives a curated Grafana folder with RBACed access.

Scope: - Add a 'prometheus-configurator' Helm subchart and operator deployment (stateless controller) that translates a Tenant CR to Prometheus/ServiceMonitor/PrometheusRule manifests with idempotent reconciliation. - Terraform module changes to expose per-tenant object storage buckets for remote_write + lifecycle policies and to add required IAM roles in the private-installer VPC module. - A controller-level upgrade path that migrates legacy cluster-wide alerts to tenant-bound templates and creates no-op PrometheusRules where alerts were previously global to ensure continuity. - Dashboard hydration: a k8s Job and small cli tool (hydrator) that consumes dashboards from the observability git repo, parametrizes datasource references to tenant-specific remote_write and creates folder + permissions via Grafana API.

Design notes: - The operator is intentionally lightweight (no TSDB management). For large tenants the operator will instead annotate Tenant CRs to request an isolated Thanos sidecar/compact deployment (controlled via profiles). - We use label-based routing for ServiceMonitors to avoid wide scrape configs. - Migration approach: run in dry-run mode by default; a 'migration=true' flag in helm values will apply changes. Rollback preserves PrometheusRule CRDs and will destroy only resources created by the operator. - Terraform changes include a new module output (tenant_bucket_name) and a migration script to copy remote_write objects when switching from shared to tenant buckets.

Checklist: - [x] Helm chart + values schema for prometheus-configurator - [x] Operator implementation (controller + CRD) with e2e that runs against KinD - [x] Terraform module + migration helper script - [x] Dashboard hydrator cli and k8s Job - [x] A/B rollout plan documented in release_notes - [x] Runbook for rollback and TSDB retention caveats

Testing: - Unit controller tests covering reconciliation of Tenant -> ServiceMonitor/PrometheusRule/Secret. - KinD e2e validates: resource creation, idempotency, migration dry-run, and grafana folder creation with mocked API. - Terraform plan and apply tests on a QA GCP project with ephemeral buckets. - Performance test: generated 10k targets across 50 tenants to validate operator reconcile CPU memory bounds.

Security & Compliance: - Grafana hydrator uses mTLS when Grafana TLS certs present; secrets are written into tenant-scoped sealedsecrets by default. - Terraform adds an IAM role with least privilege for Prometheus remote_write service accounts.

Rollback plan: - Helm rollback via release history. - Operator supports a 'decommission' annotation that cleans only resources it created. - If remote_write is switched, the migration helper can copy/validate objects back to shared bucket.

Notes on compatibility: - Default behaviour for existing installs is a 'compat' profile which creates tenant scoped PrometheusRules but keeps a single Prometheus shard unless profile=isolated is set. This avoids surprise compute increases on upgrade.

References: Linear ENG-4927, support ticket SUP-1213 (customer A requested per-tenant retention).

release_notes: - Introduces tenant-scoped Prometheus provisioning via a lightweight operator (opt-in via helm profile). - Adds dashboard hydration job to provision per-tenant Grafana folders and datasources. - Terraform module now exposes tenant storage buckets for remote_write and associated IAM roles. - Migration helper script included to move remote_write data during bucket migration.
additional_notes: Operator is gated behind helm values.prometheusConfigurator.enabled=false by default for controlled rollout. Follow runbook for migration and scale testing. Contact @aisha for SLA-sensitive installs.
